sources.entry: LosslessCut - Cross platform tool for quick and lossless video and audio trimming using ffmpeg. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut)
LosslessCut - The swiss army knife of lossless video/audio editing without re-encoding.

summary.one_liner: LosslessCut is a cross-platform FFmpeg-based GUI for fast, lossless trimming, cutting, merging and remuxing of video, audio and subtitle files.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes lossless cutting and trimming of video and audio by direct data copy rather than re-encoding, so quality is preserved and cuts are fast. It can merge cut segments or files with identical codecs, and add, remove, replace or extract audio, subtitle and other tracks. It can change container format (for example MKV to MP4) without re-encoding. It supports segments, markers and tags with import/export of chapters, CSV and EDL, and can detect scenes, black frames and silence to split by them. It also offers metadata and rotation editing, snapshots and frame export, keyboard shortcuts, a CLI and an HTTP API. Files with codecs the built-in Chromium player cannot handle are played via FFmpeg-assisted playback, and exports still come from the original file.
use_cases: Trim long camera or GoPro recordings without re-encoding
Cut out good parts of a video and discard the rest
Remux MKV to MP4 without quality loss
Extract or remove audio and subtitle tracks from a video
Merge lossless video segments with matching codecs
Split a video automatically at scene changes or silence
Add chapters or markers to a video file
how_to_run: Download the macOS DMG (Intel or Apple Silicon) from the GitHub releases, noting PKG does not work
Or install from the Snap Store on Linux, or use the x64 AppImage or tar.bz2 builds
Unofficial Flathub builds exist but are not maintained by the author
notable: Near-instant cutting because it copies data directly instead of re-encoding
FFmpeg-assisted playback opens almost any format FFmpeg can decode
Scene, black frame and silence detection for automatic splitting
Includes a CLI and HTTP API alongside the GUI
Available across macOS, Windows, Linux and Raspberry Pi
caveats: macOS PKG and Windows APPX installers do not work; use DMG or 7zip builds
Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 are no longer supported after v3.50.0
Raspberry Pi armv7l build does not include FFmpeg
Some codecs such as H265 rely on hardware decoding for smooth browser playback
